title: blp-research
description: Companion code for a four-study research program on the Bank of Thailand's Business Liaison Program (BLP): anonymization and coding of Thai-language interview notes (lexicon, LLM and ensemble coders against a gold standard), sector-weighted and composition-adjusted diffusion indices, pseudo-real-time nowcasting with Clark-West and Diebold-Mariano tests, a retrieval-augmented drafting assistant that cites a source for every sentence and blocks numbers it cannot verify, and the design and power analysis of a randomized crossover experiment on report-preparation time. Runs end to end on synthetic data. Companion software to the preprint "From Liaison Notes to Regional Indicators: Text-Based Measurement of Regional Economic Activity from Business Liaison Program Data and a Randomized Evaluation of a Generative-AI Report-Drafting Assistant".
